messages:
marie: Quick sync on model catalog compare UX. Two pequeño nits: filter chip ghosting after toggling compare, and the 'Perf' badge label causing confusion in customer calls. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/compare-ghost.png

dan: I reported the chip ghost earlier. Repro: apply 'gpu' + 'fp16', select 2 rows, close compare, then switch to 'All models' 94 chips still look active.

oliver: Likely CSS class not removed on route change. Also we should avoid visual-only states that disagree with underlying data.

rachel: Accessibility: VoiceOver reads chips as "selected" even when list is unfiltered. That mismatch is confusing. We should either make chips reflect only data state or add an explicit visual cue for transient state.

marie: Proposal: 1) Keep chips strictly tied to applied filter state (truth in data layer). 2) If we need transient UI hints (e.g., items selected for compare), use a different look (outline + subtle label "compare-only").

dan: Agree. For pinned versions: current filled-pin icon is same as list pin. Suggest bookmark + small label "Pinned v2" to reduce ambiguity.

oliver: Microcopy: change badge text from "Perf" to "Latency" and hover tooltip: "Median latency @ 512 tokens (ms). Lower is better." Keeps things unambiguous in calls.

rachel: Keyboard focus: when compare drawer opens, focus should go to the drawer heading, and pressing Esc should close and restore focus to the last focused row. Add aria-modal and ensure background is inert.

access-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure chip state exposed via aria-pressed, drawer uses role=dialog aria-modal=true, live region announces pin changes like "Pinned version 2025-02-14 for Model X".

marie: Action items: Dan 94 quick CSS fix to remove visual-only active class on route change (due Mon). Oliver 94 mock bookmark icon + pinned label in Figma (due Tue). Rachel 94 update aria flow and live-region phrasing (due Tue). I'll coordinate QA after changes.

dan: I'll also add a unit test that toggles views and asserts no active chip classes remain.

marie: Thanks team 94 prioritize chip fix + latency label for patch release.
